what: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: markermd Shiny-based grading environment assignments submitted git repositories containing Quarto (.qmd) R Markdown (.Rmd) documents, classroom layouts produced ghclass’s org_grade_assignment(). submission parsed document tree (via q2r), validated structural requirements assignment, graded question question fast, hotkey-driven rubric interface. Everything (template, rubric, recorded grading) lives per-project SQLite database. package built around two apps: template() authors grading template: document sections questions, structural rules answer must satisfy. mark() grades collection student repositories template per-question rubrics. Around apps, set helper functions (validate_project(), template_import() / template_export(), rubric_import() / rubric_export(), marks_import() / marks_export() / marks_set(), export_marks()) makes entire workflow scriptable, bundled Claude Code skills can scaffold template rubric apply rubric across submissions first pass human review.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: markermd project directory containing student repositories, optionally solution (key) repository rendered reports: init_project() detects key repository artifact directories, records everything hw01/.markermd/config.yml, creates SQLite database stores template, rubric, grading. project_sitrep() prints overview project’s configuration point.
code: hw01/ ├── repos/ │   ├── student1-hw01/ │   │   └── assignment.qmd │   ├── student2-hw01/ │   └── ... ├── html/              # rendered reports, shown while grading └── hw01-key/          # solution repository (optional) library(markermd)  # One-time setup: writes .markermd/config.yml, creates the grading # database, and installs the bundled Claude Code skills init_project("hw01")  # Author the grading template (questions + validation rules) template("hw01")  # Grade the student repositories mark("hw01")

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: template app loads assignment (project’s key repository, single .qmd/.Rmd file directory, saved template, GitHub <owner>/<repo>) displays structure interactive tree. Headings selectable units: selecting one maps document section beneath question. question gets validation rules (counts chunks, markdown blocks, node types; content checks; name checks) along optional filters narrow nodes rules see. Point values part template; question’s total set rubric grading. app opened initialized project, saving writes template directly project database, ready grading.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: mark() opens initialized project sources everything : student repositories, stored template, grading database, repository’s rendered reports.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: Validation tab checks every repository template’s rules, structural problems (missing sections, missing chunks, absent content) visible grading starts. assignment table tracks per-repository validation status grading progress.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: Rubric tab grading happens. left pane shows student’s rendered report source; right pane shows current question’s rubric. Items toggle click number-key hotkey, score follows question’s scoring setup (additive deduction mode, optional clamping zero question total; clicking score display edits total, gear popover holds mode bounds). items two comment boxes: public, student-facing comment (also marks question graded) private notes never shared students. Every action autosaves project database. Rubric items can added, edited, reordered grading, rubric pane’s menu offers YAML import export editing rubric outside app.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: Everything apps also available headlessly: YAML formats validated bundled JSON Schemas (see system.file("schema", package = "markermd")) deliberately simple enough LLM tools author. Marks imports conservative default: repository/question pairs already grading activity skipped unless explicitly overwritten.
code: # Check every student repository against the stored template validate_project("hw01")  # Templates, rubrics, and recorded marks round trip between the # project database and editable YAML files template_export("hw01-template.yaml", project = "hw01") rubric_import("hw01-rubric.yaml", project = "hw01") marks_export("hw01-marks.yaml", project = "hw01")  # Record marks for a single repository/question pair marks_set("student1-hw01", "Question 2",   items = "Looks good",   private_comment = "Quartiles and summary statistics all present.",   project = "hw01" )

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: grading complete, export_marks() writes final hand-artifacts project database (run export_scores() export_comments() individually): export_scores() writes scores.csv project root: one row per repository, one column per question, plus total column. Scores recomputed exactly mark() displays , passing question’s selected rubric item points grading mode bounds. Ungraded repository/question pairs export NA, repository’s total stays NA questions graded. export_comments() writes repository’s student-facing feedback comments/<repo>.md (project’s configured comments directory). graded question appears heading, template order, followed bulleted list selected rubric item descriptions public comment. Private notes never exported, repository public feedback gets file.

title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for R Markdown Assignments
text: init_project() installs three Claude Code skills project’s .claude/skills/ directory: markermd-scaffold-template: builds starter grading template key repository’s assignment document. markermd-scaffold-rubric: drafts per-question rubric items scoring key, optionally sampling student submissions anticipate common mistakes. markermd-apply-rubric: applies stored rubric every student repository first-pass machine grading, recording reasoning private notes human review mark(). See inst/skills/README.md details per-user installation.
